steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Hoshiguma! Hoshiguma! Can you hear me?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Can you hear—

steps.name: Lazy Yakuza
steps.text: Quit yappin'!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Hoshi—

steps.name: Lazy Yakuza
steps.text: You know what, yap all you want, we'll give that aho a warm welcome!

spans.text: You know what, yap all you want, we'll give that

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What does Kinbee want with me?

steps.name: Lazy Yakuza
steps.text: Kinbee? Who's that?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I mean, Mifune.

steps.name: Lazy Yakuza
steps.text: How am I supposed to know? You're an idol, so maybe the oyabun has some use for you. Or maybe he just plans to do you in.

steps.name: Lazy Yakuza
steps.text: Should've buttered him up more with that pretty face of yours. I don't know what you're thinking.

steps.name: Lazy Yakuza
steps.text: Bakayaro, who the heck's texting me? Everyone knows I got assigned last-minute guard duty—

spans.text: , who the heck's texting me? Everyone knows I got assigned last-minute guard duty—

steps.name: Lazy Yakuza
steps.text: What? Some other unlucky sod's taking over the shift?

steps.name: Lazy Yakuza
steps.text: Ya—hoo!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: He's gone.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What happened? Why did I feel like I was hearing voices... even talking to Hoshiguma?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Am I going crazy?
Behind—you—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Eek!
Pfft!
So you weren't acting in those shows. I didn't believe it when Kichisei told me.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: You know Kichisei? Is she alright?
Locked up, like you, but probably safe for now.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Wh-Who are you?
You can call me Sarasa. I'm a fan of yours, and I guess you could say I'm Mifune's employee, but my true identity is an undercover cyber ninja!

spans.text: You can call me Sarasa. I'm a fan of yours, and I guess you could say I'm Mifune's employee, but my true identity is an undercover

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Cyber... ninja? How's that different from a regular ninja?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Look, ninja are nothing more than hired killers. But the cyber kind? We're wanderers of the intercity net!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: But I thought cyber ninja were pretty much the same, hired by corporations to attack each other, just specializing in intercity net operations?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Fine, I'm a cyber ronin ninja!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: But I don't know where you came from, or why you're helping me—

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: That video that you saw at home, the one where Mifune and Mio plot to infect you with Oripathy? I was the one who leaked it to warn you! Do you trust me now?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: You were the one who gave me that fright in the middle of the night?!

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Well, it was the first time I worked on a Mitsukue—I mean, the Kinseki Channel signal system. It was a mistake. I didn't do it on purpose, I promise!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: A-Alright... well, I guess I do owe you my life...

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Honestly, I only applied to Kinseki Channel because I heard it was the biggest TV station in Mitsukue, and I needed a job.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: But the longer I worked, the more things began to stink. But at least they had you as their poster girl... but they wouldn't even keep their hands off you!

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Especially that Mifune. I would've just kept my head down and did the work I was paid for, if he wasn't so yabai.

spans.text: Especially that Mifune. I would've just kept my head down and did the work I was paid for, if he wasn't so

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: But I'd rather jump into the sea than work another day for that piece of shit.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: ...Hehe.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: I located Hoshiguma using Mifune's monitoring network, so I patched you in briefly.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: You can do that? I remember how the technical director spent a long time fumbling with a pre-set connection the last time I was live on air...

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: That just means he sucks at his job.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Now, listen to me. I'll patch you in with Hoshiguma again, and have her wait outside.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: We'll take Kichisei. Listen to me, and I'll make sure those stupid yakuza never even catch a glimpse of your shadow.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: No, I can't go.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Are you crazy? Do you WANT Mifune to cut you up into burdenbeast feed?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Where can I go, if I leave?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: The Southern Court's a big place. Plenty of places you can go.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Lay low the rest of my life, always looking over my shoulder? No way.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I didn't give myself the name Momoka Hanyuu, but if you tell me I have to give it up now...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: How's that any different from being dead?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Are you serious? Aren't you afraid to die? Do you have a death wish or something?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I don't know. All I know is that it's the only path I have left.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Fine. You know what, that sounded really cool, like a line straight out of a movie. You're a star for a reason!

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: How do you plan on continuing to be a star, then? What if Kinbee won't let you?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Whoever stands in my way... they're gonna find out that even I can bite when backed into a corner.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Didn't Kinbee make up all those kaidan stories? I'll tell all Mitsukue that they've been lied to.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Interesting.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Can you connect me to every TV set in Mitsukue? I'm going to expose Kinbee to the entire city.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: How long do you think it's gonna take, hacking all those TVs, one at a time?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: But they're doing that accession ceremony and broadcasting it to the whole city. All we need to do is take a ride on it.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: You still have that broken sword? It'll come in useful.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: The first thing that Kinbee's people did when they captured us was take it from me...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: But I'll say it, with or without the evidence.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: I'll get that Kichisei girl, and Ao-Oni on the other side of the TV, and then we can talk about how we'll teach Mifune a lesson!

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Where are you?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Where are... you...?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Did I doze off?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Wait, did the kami-sama...?!
I'm not in that much of a hurry.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: It's you?!
Moriuchi sits straight with a start.
He wants to turn around, but dares not, afraid that he will learn that it is all a dream, and there is nothing there at all.
The kami seems satisfied with this reaction.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Kami-sama...

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: It... it's been a long time.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: You're finally willing to show yourself to me.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I'm very grateful that you pulled my family out of poverty.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Did you spend all these years looking for me, just to say thank you?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I wanted to thank you, of course, but there was also something I wanted to ask.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Why... why did you leave us? Why was it that we lost our happy life, little by little, until it was all gone?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Did we offend you? Or was it fate that not even you could avert... and that was why you chose to avoid us?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: What does any of that have to do with me?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I-I understand, of course it couldn't be...

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: What I mean is, did you spend all these years looking for me just to learn the reason?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Were you not looking for me because you wanted to seize happiness again?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: I've said this many times, but I guess you were too young to remember, so I'll be patient and tell you once more.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: I never give anyone anything.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Think of it this way: there's something I like, and I appear in front of people when I see it.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Something... do you mean, happiness?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: I didn't avoid you because I was angry at you, or ashamed to see you. I simply chose not to see you because happiness had left you.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: But now, I have a reason to see you again.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Choose the right path, and you shall know happiness beyond your wildest dreams.
The kami's voice is exactly as he remembers, but for some reason it makes the hair on the back of his neck stand up. Is it because he has lost the innocence of childhood?
Is it because he has heard too many lies in his time?
Yes. He has heard too many lies, and he has learned to treat all beautiful promises as deception.
But this is different.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Please... tell me.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: You stand in the eye of the storm.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: The Oni, Hoshiguma; the snake, Kinbee. Add to that a poor goldfin, and a wolf who believes its own nose—you. All your fates are intertwined.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Oh, there was also an unfortunate old man, but he's dead now.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Tessai-san?!

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: With his death, you finally have the chance to seize the happiness that you have longed for.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: His death... my happiness? What do you mean?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Why... why is Tessai dead? Who killed him?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Is it so hard to guess?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: What you REALLY should ask yourself, though, is if it matters?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: You stand where countless people could only dream of standing, Moriuchi. This is a business opportunity, a big one. Choose right, and everything will be yours.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: You want me... to stand on Kinbee's side?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Kinbee is a liar. He wouldn't let me live.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: That's why it's a big business opportunity.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Kinbee is a liar, certainly, but he needs you. More specifically, Kinsekikai needs you.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: The separation of the Kinsekikai and the Kinseki Group has entered the final phase. Only a catastrophic event could stop it.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Everything seems to be going according to Kinbee's plan, but he's about to find that he isn't as powerful as he thought.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: You've survived for so long between the overworld and underworld of Kajimachi and Nita Street. As a man, you're not that far off from Kinbee.
Moriuchi is stunned.
In his mind, he fantasied about his reunion with the Kami countless times, but never in another thousand years could he have imagined that It would so calmly tell him something so...
...Terrifying.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: You want me to take Kinbee's place? Is that the happiness that you're talking about?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: What if I take his place, but find it beyond my abilities...?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: But you'll be rich. Very rich.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Rich...?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: You'll be rich, whether you have the ability or not. Maybe not as rich as Kinbee is... but the kind of wealth that you could hardly even imagine right now.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Is money not happiness?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Was it not money that you and your family found when you were young?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Is it not because of money that Mitsukue, and this country, enjoy endless happiness?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Where would happiness be if money left you?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: ...Is this the lesson you have for me?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: It's not a lesson, just the simplest law of existence.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Kinbee knows it. The Diet knows it. Virtually everyone in Mitsukue knows it... you knew it too, when you were little.
Moriuchi feels a chill come over him, as though the setting sun is suffocating in its own golden rays.
Is this really the Kami that he encountered when he was young?
Or is this simply an absurd nightmare... no, something trying to deceive him and make him abandon his search for the kami?
But Its mannerisms, the way It talks, even the line 'What does any of that have to do with me?'... he has never forgotten them.
In Moriuchi's memory, even those cold words seemed to be a kind of encouragement. Now, though...
Moriuchi is gasping for air, but the cold nightmare seems inexorably suffocating.
He reaches into his pocket and takes out the key.
There are numerous scratches on the old-fashioned key, with a tiny maneki-neko hanging from the keychain.
It has kept him company for many years.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Money is happiness, you say?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Maybe. Maybe that's what I always thought, deep inside.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: But did you ever stop to think... before all that happened, I only ever thought of you as a friend, the only friend of a lonely boy?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: The friend brought me happiness, for which I was very grateful, but could never repay. You had no intention to accept everything that I did.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: When you disappeared after I failed to come to see you for a while, I thought it must be because I had neglected you.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I thought I deserved it, because I had abandoned my only friend.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: You know? I almost did the exact same thing when I was being coerced by Mifune.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: The Oni?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Yes. My guts wrenched in shame when she came to rescue me, but I couldn't say anything.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: But you just told me that I got it backwards all along. It wasn't you who brought me happiness. You simply came to me because happiness was there.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I see. You're a kami... you've never been any more or less than a kami.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I'm sorry for my arrogance, to think that I could befriend a kami, never mind trying to catch its tail.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Thank you for coming to see me, and telling me that I have been walking down the wrong path my entire life.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: How could an information broker have any true friends?
Moriuchi raises the keys and takes off the maneki-neko accessory.
He looks at the keychain, as though he is talking to the kami behind it.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: But I wanted a friend. A true friend.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Can you understand that? Would it make you... angry?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: If you're not angry... might I be so presumptuous as to... make a bet with you?
Moriuchi stretches out his hand, into the sky unobstructed by concrete.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: If I do as you say...

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I'll never have a true friend for the rest of my life...

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I'll never have true happiness.
He bites his lip and opens up his trembling hand.
The accessory falls straight down, like any ordinary object, and is soon swallowed by the dark streets beneath the setting sun.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: ...Sayounara.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: To find Hoshiguma. If Tessai's dead, as you said, then I have to go and help Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Nosy Kami
steps.text: She's in the back alley of Nita Street. The one with that tiny shrine.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Huh... huh?

steps.name: Nosy Kami
steps.text: What are you huhing for? It's me?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Maneki-Neko-sama, It—
Moriuchi turns around to see nothing, as though nothing was there to begin with, except for the orange-yellow glow of dusk.
He turns his head to the front, and sees the Nosy Kami floating in the air in front.

steps.name: Nosy Kami
steps.text: That neko left because you rejected It. Does that surprise you?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Then... why did you help me?

steps.name: Nosy Kami
steps.text: It's not me who wanted to help you. The star of our shrine told me to help you if I have time, for all the chikuwa offerings you made.

steps.name: Nosy Kami
steps.text: That neko could've done it Itself! Hmph!

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Thank you for the help, and pass on my thanks to that... er... 'star'?

steps.name: Nosy Kami
steps.text: Don't expect me to help you fight. I'm just pointing the way.

steps.name: Nosy Kami
steps.text: After all, both of us have a score to settle with that bastard Mifune.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Moriuchi-san?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Did you come to help me, or stop me?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Help.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Did you find your kami-sama, then?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: It's doing fine. Much better than I am. But It has nothing to do with me, now that I've found It.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Where's Momoka? Isn't she with you?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I was about to go in and rescue her—

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Moriuchi? Is that Moriuchi?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: The TV?

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Moriuchi-san! Momoka told me your oden's the best in Higashi! I want to try it, once this is all over and done with.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Call me Sarasa, but we don't have time for introductions right now!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Momoka, Kichisei, get closer to the mic! Time to make battle plans!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Mitsukue's in for a BIG surprise!
